articles.title: Get Ready, Europe: A Total Solar Eclipse Is Coming—And It’s a Once-in-a-Lifetime Show!
articles.summary: On August 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will turn day into night for parts of Europe for the first time since 1999. The Sun will vanish for about two minutes, and Spain gets three eclipses in three years!

articles.title: Splash Alert! Teens Battle It Out in the Pool at the 2026 U.S. Junior Nationals
articles.summary: At the 2026 U.S. Junior National Championships, swimmers like Gabi Brito and Syunta Lee are making waves. Brito crushed the 200 IM prelims, and Lee is the favorite in the boys' 200 IM after a blazing 2:02.11 best time.

articles.title: Whoa! 'The Odyssey' Sails Past $1 Billion at the Box Office—And It's Not Done Yet!
articles.summary: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' has crossed $1 billion in global ticket sales in just three weeks. It's his first movie to hit that mark since 'The Dark Knight Rises,' and it hasn't even opened in China yet!
